concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work. Compiler-emitted structures are fresh and owned by the caller; the volatile run envelope is the only per-call value and never enters the plan body.
inputs: normalized System, Component and referenced resources
note: Successor revision. Adds the declared core-parameter projection cases demanded by XDL1-RVW-002 and detailed-design.md sections 5, 7 (frozen field rules) and 17. The declared-core count bound itself is negatively exercised by XDL1-SR-019-U::test_max_parameters_declared_core_scope_exceeded_rejected.
purpose: Compile declared System, Component, Interface, Endpoint and flow intent into the resolved plan using the existing XDL v1alpha1 semantic entities, without introducing a new top-level resource kind or a competing configuration language. Project every declared core parameter of the selected System and of each referenced Component into components[].declaredParameters: Component.spec.parameters[] into that Component's component-instance entry and System.spec.parameters[] into exactly one always-present components[scope="system"] entry emitted first, with no silent drop and no duplication. Resolves XDL1-RVW-002.
state: Stateless projection of declared normalized content onto the frozen plan sections.

static_checks.expected: grep of experiment_plan.py and the emitted plan shows no new top-level kind literal
static_checks.rule: only the five accepted v1alpha1 kind strings appear in emitted plan sections
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse, jsonschema meta-schema validation, additive diff scope check)
